text:
sophie: Heads-up — sunrise maintenance window in ~2h. Need final owners for pin/unpin, canary group, and rollback. I'm running coordination from this thread. @kevin @jordan
kevin: On it. I'll pin v3.4.1 to the dedicated pool and warm the canary. Monitoring dashboards up.
jordan: I’ll own rollback & smoke. Nominate me first responder.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled 2024-05-18T06:00Z -> canary to eu-west-1. Estimated bake: 12m. Preflight checks queued.
sophie: Kevin — if canary shows errors, what's the immediate play?
kevin: Immediate actions: abort traffic shift, scale down canary replicas, re-route to stable, then figure hotfix. Quick commands in case we need them:
```
# abort traffic shift
deploy-bot abort --rollout canary-1715009999
# rollback service
kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api --to-revision=271
```
jordan: Smoke scripts ready, will run `scripts/smoke_launch.sh` right after canary finishes and paste results here (expect ~10m).
mike: Ops note: networking will keep BGP sessions warm; I'll watch p95 and retransmits.
ops-bot: Alert policy "canary-latency-eu" is active. Thresholds: p95 > 180ms => page oncall. Also monitoring embedding-cost-spike metric.
kevin: Add cost mitigation: if tokens/sec >1.2x baseline then reduce batch size 50% and scale down noncritical pools (manual). I have a script staged to change batch config.
sophie: Capturing fallback matrix here:
- canary fail fast -> abort traffic, rollback to stable, 30m cooling, postmortem if >2% error increase
- transient latency/cost spike -> reduce batch + enable quantized variant -> continue monitoring
- persistent functional errors -> abort launch, notify partners and support
jordan: I'm oncall 06:00-07:00UTC and will own the first 20m of verification. This thread is handover channel? @sophie
sophie: Yes — handover channel = this thread.
kevin: Unpin list prepared: svc-embed-v2, svc-gen-legacy. Will unpin after successful post-canary smoke.
sophie: Support ask: release notes in #release-notes by EOD so support has triage context.
kevin: Drafting notes now, will post in 30m.
deploy-bot: Canaries warmed locally. Preflight summary: db migrations no-op, config checksum OK, image digests match manifest.
sophie: Great. Starting T-15m checklist at 05:45UTC. Please confirm readiness in thread before I hit the go channel. Good luck everyone.
mike: :rocket: all green from infra side.
kevin: Confirmed from my side.
jordan: Confirmed, smoke scripts staged.
sophie: Locking this thread for cadence; call me if anything urgent. :eyes:
